title: Explain a Purchase Decision

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a friend about a fictional market purchase. Compare two products, explain one contrast and the final price, and describe a question you would ask the seller. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先介绍需求和两个选择；再比较质量与价格，使用 although、despite 或 however；最后说明付款前要问什么以及选择理由。

reference: At a fictional market, I wanted a bag for my books. One vendor offered a cotton product, and another seller showed me a wool one. Although the wool bag looked warm, it did not fit my folder. The cotton bag had a clear tag and a useful pocket. It was on sale for eighteen dollars, and a coupon reduced the payment to sixteen dollars. Before buying it, I asked the merchant about the written warranty and read the exact terms. A well known brand can be helpful, but it does not prove the quality by itself. I chose the cotton bag because it was comfortable and seemed durable. I put my purse away only after checking the final price. I think the best value for a consumer depends on what the buyer actually needs, not just on the word bargain.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
